programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Teenage Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), from New Jersey to Los Angeles.He becomes friends with his peer Tommy (Rob Garrison).During a beach party, the boy meets a nice blonde, Ali (Elisabeth Shue).The two immediately take a liking to each other, which does not please her ex-boyfriend, Johnny (William Zabka).As an excellent karateka, he easily teaches his rival a lesson.Humiliated, Daniel also decides to start training eastern martial arts to defeat the enemy.Unfortunately, he cannot join the local club because Johnny and his equally unpleasant and brutal friends practice there.One evening, Daniel is attacked by them again.He is saved from trouble by an old man, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), who turns out to be a master of eastern martial arts.From then on, the teenager learns the secrets of karate under his watchful eye.The Japanese teaches him not only the fighting style, but also a lot about life... A perfect film for karate lovers.For his role as Master Noriyuki "Pat" Morita, he received an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Golden Globe nomination.Director of photography John G. Avildsen is known as the creator of the legendary "Rocky" from 1976 with Sylvester Stallone.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spencer (Alex Wolff) is not feeling well at college in New York and is losing confidence again.During the Christmas break spent at home, he reaches for the console to return to the adventurous world of Jumanji.To save him, Martha (Morgan Turner), Bethany (Madison Iseman) and Fridge (Ser'Darius Blain) immediately spring into action.However, it turns out that the rules of the game have changed a lot.They cannot take on their former avatars and must switch roles.Soon, as the adventurer Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), the warrior Ruby Roundhouse (Karen Gillan), the Mouse (Kevin Hart) and the frightened Professor Sheldon Oberon (Jack Black) go deep not only into the jungle, but also into endless deserts and dangerous mountain ranges.They face many threats and a certain cunning villain (Rory McCann).Continuation of "Jumanji: Adventure in the Jungle" from 2017.

programme.title: Avenue of the Giants
programme.desc: California.For years, 74-year-old Herbert Heller hid from his family his traumatic experiences during World War II and his stay in the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp, where he was sent at the age of twelve, and three years later he attempted to escape.All this changes when he meets Abbey (Fisher), rejected by his peers, whose own difficult experiences prompt him to open up.A moving, healing friendship develops between a man and a teenager.The story is based on the true memories of Herbert Heller, a former concentration camp prisoner who settled in the USA after the war.

programme.title: The A List: 15 Stories From Asian And Pacific Diasporas
programme.desc: Actors, activists, athletes and influential Asian Americans participate in a series of intimate interviews.In front of the camera were, among others:Sandra Oh and Kumail Nanjiani.

programme.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programme.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programme.title: The Killer's Game
programme.desc: Joe Flood, one of the best contract killers, learns about an incurable disease and places a contract on himself.However, the murderess is targeting his ex-girlfriend.Joe decides to save her.

programme.title: Vinci 2
programme.desc: Cuma receives an offer to participate in a new heist.At first he refuses, but changes his mind when he learns that his old rival, Chudy, is planning a spectacular robbery in Krakow without his participation.

programme.title: Greta Gerwig: Itinerary Of A Rising Star
programme.desc: A profile of the actress, screenwriter and director who became famous for her bold role in the comedy-drama "Frances Ha", as well as as co-author of the brilliant adaptation of "Little Women" and the record-breaking film "Barbie".Thanks to these productions, in less than a decade, Greta Gerwig became both an icon of independent cinema and a hit filmmaker.In 2024, she also served as president of the jury at the Cannes Film Festival.What additionally distinguishes her are her feminist beliefs.The artist's interests have always been focused on women and the fight against stereotypes.

programme.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programme.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her unlucky fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programme.title: Shrek the Halls
programme.desc: After many dramatic adventures, Shrek dreams only of resting in the comfort of his home.However, he is not given peace.Christmas is approaching.Everyone, without exception, succumbs to the Christmas euphoria of preparing for the magical days of the year.Meanwhile, the ogre cannot surrender to the overwhelmingly solemn atmosphere because he hates holidays.However, he does not want to disappoint Fiona and the children, so he decides to get involved in the ceremonial preparations.His miserable struggles are watched by his faithful friends - Donkey, Puss in Boots and Biscuit.Embarrassed by the ogre's clumsiness and lack of good taste, they decide to help him.Soon, thanks to their efforts, Shrek's house is thrown into chaos.This promises to be the most terrifying Christmas in the life of an ogre, a lover of peace and quiet... The next adventure of Shrek in a special TV version.In the Polish language version, famous actors provided their voices, including:Jerzy Stuhr and Zbigniew Zamachowski.

programme.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
programme.desc: A few months after his arrest, Gellert Grindelwald manages to escape while being escorted to the Old Continent.Soon he begins to gather allies.His goal is to establish the domination of wizards over muggles throughout the world.He easily manages to convince his brethren to fight against humans.Professor Albus Dumbledore asks his former student Newt Scamander for help.So the magizoologist sets out to find Credence Barebone, who has hidden in Paris.Grindelwald is also heading there, intending to convince the boy to join him.They are followed by Tina, who is in love with a lover of unusual animals without reciprocity.Once again, Jacob Kowalski will be involved in a magical intrigue, and with him his beloved, slightly eccentric sorceress Queenie.However, the Muggle's careless behavior will put their relationship to the test.The secret hidden by the Lestrange family will also be revealed.

programme.title: Death Of A Comedian
programme.desc: Argentine actor Juan Debré (Diego Peretti) receives a disturbing diagnosis at the peak of his career.He escapes to Belgium to immerse himself in his own, safe reality.

credits.actor: Waiter in Brussels city - Andrés Guillín
Passenger at the tram stop - Elodie Barthels

programme.title: Soul On Fire
programme.desc: Nine-year-old John O'Leary suffers burns to almost his entire body.He struggles with pain and limitations.However, he wins love and makes his dreams come true.He inspires others by showing how to live life to the fullest.

programme.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, a meteorite falls on the zoo.Thanks to him, some of the inhabitants turn into neon, jelly-like creatures with suspicious properties, and the entire zoo is thrown into chaos.The clever wolf Gracie and the haughty puma Dan, who have been out of each other's way until now, decide to put aside their personal grudges to save the animals.Together with a group of daredevils, including Frida the capybara, Felix the baboon, Ash the nervous ostrich, Xavier the lemur and the charming Hippo, they create a crazy rescue team.The Polish language version was attended by, among others:Magdalena Boczarska, Marcin Piętowski and Mateusz Banasiuk.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Sherry Parker (Taraji P. Henson) is offered a job in Beijing.He goes there with his son Dre (Jaden Smith).The boy cannot acclimatize to the new surroundings.For this reason, he often comes into conflict with his school friends.He is also persecuted by them.One day, Dre meets Mr. Han (Jackie Chan), the caretaker of the building where he lives with his mother.The man decides to teach the boy martial arts so that he can defend himself against his peers who bully him.Many hours of training create a unique bond between them, much stronger than ordinary teacher-student relationships.The film's script loosely refers to John G. Avildsen's work from 1984.The production received nominations for the Teen and People's Choice awards, Czarny Repules and the Golden Popcorn award.

programme.title: Closer
programme.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programme.title: Bastille Day
programme.desc: On the eve of Bastille Day, an American thief living in Paris, Michael Mason (Richard Madden), steals a bag containing a teddy bear.Not knowing that there is a bomb hidden inside the toy, he takes the money and documents and throws the rest into a trash bin in a crowded Paris metro station.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Four people die.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

credits.actor: Joe Garcia, ojciec Jenny - Michael Pena

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
programme.desc: The powerful and cruel magician Gellert Grindelwald (Mads Mikkelsen) intends to take over both the world of wizards and ordinary muggles.Professor Albus Dumbledore (Jude Law) knows about his plans and wants to stop him, but due to their blood pact, he cannot fight him.So he entrusts this task to magizoologist Newt Scamander (Eddie Redmayne).The wizard creates a team that includes his assistant Bunty (Victoria Yeates), brother Theseus (Callum Turner), defensive charms teacher Eulalie Hicks (Jessica Williams), a relative of the murdered Leta Lestrange - Yusuf Kama (William Nadylam), and Muggle baker Jacob Kowalski (Dan Fogler).The last member of the team wants to free his beloved, Queenie (Alison Sudol), from Grindelwald's power.During a dangerous mission, they will all come face to face with known and unknown animals and will fight with increasingly numerous followers of the cruel magician.An adaptation of another famous novel by J.K.Rowling.

programme.title: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
programme.desc: The film presents the career and extraordinary life of Robin Williams described mainly in his words.Never-before-published materials were used in the making of the documentary.The film also includes interviews with the actor's closest people, who outline his work style.Featuring: Billy Crystal, Eric Idle, Whoopie Goldberg, David Letterman, Steve Martin, Pam Dawber and Robin's son - Zakie.The film is directed by two-time Emmy Award winner Marina Zenovich (Roman Polański. Fugitive and Desired).

programme.title: Eine Million Minuten
programme.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and replacing her children with a father.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programme.title: P.S. I Love You
programme.desc: After the death of her husband Gerry (Gerard Butler), Holly (Hilary Swank) falls into a deep depression.On her 30th birthday, a woman receives a mysterious parcel.The cake comes with a tape with a recorded message from... Gerry.He encourages his beloved to go out and have fun with friends.After this event, new letters regularly arrived to the young widow, each ending with a declaration of love.Gerry knew how much his wife would suffer from losing him.In letters written before her death, he encourages her to take on various challenges.Thanks to her extraordinary sense of connection with the deceased, a woman in despair undergoes specific therapy and tries to start her life anew.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Li Fong's friend needs help.He decided to take part in a karate tournament, but his skills are insufficient.Teacher Han turns to the legendary Daniel LaRusso for help.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean grew up in a broken home.He never planned to build a lasting relationship until he met Cindy, with whom he fell in love at first sight.When, after a few weeks of dating, it turns out that the girl is expecting another man's child, she makes the difficult decision to get married.The couple tries to create a happy family, but over time they begin to face a serious crisis.The infatuation disappears, and everyday problems make it difficult for them to find understanding.Dean abuses alcohol and does simple physical work, unable to guarantee his wife real stability and support.The couple falls into conflicts more and more often.However, he still tries to rebuild his relationships for the sake of little Frankie.This perfectly portrayed study of the breakdown of a relationship was nominated for the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival.The role of Michelle Williams was nominated for an Oscar and a Golden Globe.
